title: Prayer to St. Michael
text:
St. Michael the Archangel, defend us in battle,
be our protection against the wickedness and snares of the devil.
May God rebuke him we humbly pray;
and do thou, O Prince of the Heavenly host,
by the power of God, cast into hell Satan
and all the evil spirits who prowl about the world
seeking the ruin of souls.
Amen.

translation.latin:
Sancte Michael Archangele, defende nos in proelio;
contra nequitiam et insidias diaboli esto praesidium.
Imperet illi Deus, supplices deprecamur;
tuque, Princeps militiae caelestis,
Satanam aliosque spiritus malignos,
qui ad perditionem animarum pervagantur in mundo,
divina virtute in infernum detrude.
Amen.

notes: The Prayer to St. Michael was composed by Pope Leo XIII after reportedly having a vision of the spiritual battle between the Church and Satan. After Vatican II, it was removed from the prayers said after Mass, but Pope John Paul II encouraged Catholics to continue praying it privately for the protection of the Church.
description: The Prayer to St. Michael the Archangel is a powerful prayer for protection against evil
